title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
  
  
We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.
  
  
You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
* Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
* Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

**About The Team**
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
You build and own assigned solution streams across 1–2 concurrent projects. You implement agentic AI solutions on AWS AgentCore and LangGraph, contribute to POC delivery, and take full ownership of your components in production — including Pro Code builds and Low Code automations where the use case fits.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Agentic AI Development

+ Implement LangGraph agentic workflows on AWS AgentCore — state graphs, tool orchestration, conditional routing, error recovery.
+ Build custom RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking strategy, embeddings, vector retrieval, accuracy evaluation.
+ Contribute to rapid POC delivery alongside the Architect and Lead.
+ Write production-grade Python with FastAPI, Pydantic, testing, and proper error handling.
+ Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline) to accelerate builds. Own and fix all generated code in production.

* Low Code & Automation

+ Build Low Code automations using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate when use case and bandwidth allow.
+ Understand Pro Code vs Low Code trade-offs — flag where Low Code is the better fit.
+ Stay current on Low Code platform capabilities as they expand rapidly.

* Production Ownership & Collaboration

+ Own assigned components in production — monitor, debug, optimise, iterate.
+ Debug agent failures independently: context issues, tool errors, hallucination, retrieval degradation.
+ Collaborate with the Lead on architecture translation and implementation planning.
+ Mentor Associate Developers through code reviews and pair programming.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Must Have:**

* LangGraph — State graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing — primary framework, non-negotiable.
* LangChain — Chains, memory, custom tools — solid foundational knowledge.
* AWS AgentCore — Hands-on preferred; strong LangGraph depth with ramp path acceptable.
* AWS Bedrock — Model invocation, knowledge bases, guardrails.
* Database & AI Data Access — SQL proficiency, NL-to-SQL, LLM-powered query and insight patterns. Snowflake a plus.
* RAG Pipelines — End-to-end: chunking, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation.
* Vector Databases — Pinecone, ChromaDB, OpenSearch, or FAISS — hands-on with at least one.
* Python — Production-quality — type hints, async/await, FastAPI, Pydantic.
* Multi-Model — OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama — understand trade-offs across providers.
* Pro Code vs Low Code — Copilot Studio and Power Automate — build when use case fits.
* AI Development Tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cline — accelerate delivery; own and fix all generated code.
* Experience — 3–5 years total; 1–2 years GenAI/LLM; 6–12 months LangGraph; 2–3 projects with working code.

**Good To Have**

* AWS AgentCore Deep — Runtime, Memory, Tools Gateway hands-on.
* MCP / A2A — Server/client implementation or protocol awareness.
* Enterprise Integration — SAP HANA, Salesforce connectors.
* Document Intelligence — OCR, layout-aware chunking.
* Evaluation Frameworks — RAGAS, Promptfoo, DeepEval.
* Certifications — AWS, GCP, or Azure AI/ML.

**What We Expect From You**

* Customer Obsession

+ Proactively understand customer goals and deliver measurable value.

* Competitive Drive

+ Set high standards, demonstrate tenacity, and ensure our solutions lead in quality.

* Challenging Mindset

+ Foster fact-based dialogue, challenge assumptions, and encourage disruptive thinking.

* Action and Learning Velocity

+ Build fast, fail fast, learn fast. Iterate rapidly and make data-driven decisions.

* Collaboration and Accountability

+ Collaborate across a global team with humility, ownership, and mutual accountability.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build production agentic AI at global scale — real systems, real impact.
* Work with AWS AgentCore, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, and AI-powered development tools.
* Operate in a high-trust team where Architect, Lead, Developer, and Associate work in sync.
* A culture of rapid learning, fast iteration, and genuine technical excellence.

DESRI is run by a dynamic team with offices located at New York, Denver, Portland, Houston, and Hyderabad (India).

We are looking for a resourceful and driven professional to join DESRI, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad, India office. **What You'll Do**

* Design and build LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent, along with native LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google).
* Develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs in Python, exposing capabilities via REST and gRPC.
* Build LLM-driven automations (e.g., document intelligence, workflow copilots, chat-to-action systems) to augment or replace manual processes across investment, operations, and analytics.

* Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and iteration.
* Establish evaluation and observability frameworks for LLM systems, balancing cost, latency, and reliability.
* Ensure AI safety and responsible use, including prompt-injection mitigation and PII handling.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous problems into production-grade AI solutions.
* Contribute to code reviews, system design discussions, and engineering best practices using GitHub-based workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with 3–5 years of software engineering experience and hands-on exposure to applied AI / LLM systems in production.
* Own end-to-end frontend development for internal AI tools and copilots (React, Next.js, TypeScript), including component architecture, state management, and production deployment — not limited to prototyping.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers
* Strong Python expertise with experience building scalable APIs (REST/gRPC) and production-grade backend systems.
* Hands-on experience with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and agent frameworks (LangGraph or similar), including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and building AI applications (automation, copilots).
* Experience building lightweight UIs (React, Next.js, TypeScript) and ability to prototype and iterate quickly in ambiguous environments.
* Clear communicator with a strong ownership mindset for production systems (reliability, cost, and user experience) and awareness of evaluation, observability, and AI safety best practices.

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Python, Cloud & GenAI)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.

**Job Title –**
Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead)

**Job Nature –**
Permanent

**Work Location –**
Hyderabad

**Experience –**
12+ years software engineering, of which 2+ years building production large language model / agentic applications and 4+ years leading engineers

**Purpose of the Role**

Own ArcelorMittal's agent engineering practice: reusable patterns for agent decomposition, orchestration, tool use, memory, evaluation, safeguards and operational behaviour; reference implementations on approved Microsoft agent frameworks; agent-specific test suites; and coaching of pod engineers so that agentic solutions are measurable, safe and reusable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define agent decomposition, planning, tool-use, memory, state and orchestration patterns; codify them in the agent engineering standard.
* Select and validate implementation approaches across approved Microsoft agent frameworks (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio) and the platform's agent runtime.
* Build and maintain reference implementations and reusable components (tools, connectors, orchestration, guardrails) for common agent behaviours.
* Define agent-specific tests for task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost and failure recovery; integrate them into CI/CD evaluation gates with the AI Platform Owner.
* Review pod implementations, lead code and design reviews, and coach engineers on difficult agent design problems.
* Harvest proven components and lessons from the partner-led pods into the CoE pattern library; retire unsafe or untestable patterns.
* Lead the ArcelorMittal engineering community of practice for agentic AI across Europe and the India Global Capability Centre.

**Preferred Skills**

* Stakeholder orientation
* Results orientation
* Courage to challenge
* Inspire trust
* Innovation and learning agility
* Decision making
* Cross-cultural collaboration
* Capability building and knowledge transfer

**Good to have skills**

* Production software engineering in Python and/or C#/.NET with strong testing and CI/CD discipline
* Hands-on building of large language model / agentic applications: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI), Agent Service, Semantic Kernel / Agent Framework, function calling / tools, retrieval-augmented generation and grounding
* Agent evaluation and safety engineering: evaluation datasets, model-as-judge evaluation, red-teaming, content safety, permission boundaries
* Designing for observability and operations: tracing (OpenTelemetry), telemetry, cost and latency management
* Technical leadership: code review, pattern definition, coaching
* Experience in leading team of AI Engineers, providing guidance and technical decision ability, defining strong engineering practices
* Copilot Studio and Power Platform for low-code agents; Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
* Microsoft Fabric / SQL for grounding on governed data
* Container-based runtimes (Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure API Management, Entra ID
* Certifications: AI-102, AZ-204, DP-600

**Qualifications**

Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data, Business or a relevant discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage

**Deliverables**

The successful Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead) combines strong professional depth with a practical delivery mindset. The individual must be able to establish clear methods, make sound decisions, develop colleagues and progressively assume ownership from the implementation partner. Success requires confidence working across India and Europe and balanced judgement across delivery speed, reuse, security and Responsible AI.

This role helps establish a permanent ArcelorMittal AI capability, embeds repeatable engineering and control practices, and reduces dependency on the implementation partner through structured ownership transfer. Success is demonstrated when:

* Reference patterns are reused across pods; agent behaviour (task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost, failure recovery) is measurable; permission and failure paths are tested before release; duplicated engineering effort declines; ArcelorMittal engineers can build agents independently.
* Agent engineering standard; reference implementations; reusable tools and orchestration components; agent evaluation suite; engineering review evidence; failure and recovery patterns; coaching materials.

**Time Zone**

India Standard Time (IST) with European working hours (CET/GMT) overlap

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description:
**Job title:**
Lead Solutions Engineer
  
  
**About The Job**
Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.
  
  
Join Sanofi as our
**Lead Solutions Engineer**

Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.
  
  

* This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week onsite in Hyderabad - required. \*\*

**Main Responsibilities**
**Hands-On Technical Implementation (70%)**
*Cloud-Native Architecture & Implementation*

* Design and implement hybrid cloud solutions on AWS and Azure for pharmaceutical workloads.
* Architect containerized applications using Kubernetes (EKS/AKS) with enterprise-grade reliability.
* Build Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) for rapid, consistent deployments.
* Implement cloud-native patterns (microservices, serverless, and event-driven) that support pharmaceutical compliance.

*AI/ML Infrastructure Deployment*

* Deploy and optimize AI/ML infrastructure supporting drug discovery and manufacturing automation.
* Implement AIOps platforms for intelligent infrastructure monitoring and automated operations.
* Build data pipelines and model serving infrastructure for pharmaceutical AI applications.
* Design GPU-optimized clusters and distributed computing environments for machine learning workloads.

*DevOps & Automation Excellence*

* Implement CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scanning, and compliance validation.
* Design observability platforms that provide comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting.
* Build self-service automation enabling digital teams to deploy infrastructure safely and rapidly.
* Establish GitOps practices and automated rollback mechanisms for pharmaceutical production systems.

*Hybrid Infrastructure Integration*

* Design seamless integrations between on-premises pharmaceutical systems and cloud platforms.
* Build disaster recovery and business continuity solutions meeting pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.
* Optimize hybrid cloud costs through FinOps practices and automated resource management.

**Lead Strategic Technology Vision (30%)**
*Digital Partner Solution Design*

* Lead technical architecture discussions with Digital R&D, Manufacturing, and Corporate peer organizations.
* Provide consultative guidance on cloud, AI, and infrastructure strategies for critical pharmaceutical initiatives.
* Co-design enterprise solutions that balance innovation speed with GxP compliance requirements.
* Translate business challenges into technical solutions aligned with Sanofi’s AI transformation roadmap.

*Architecture Partnership & Governance*

* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture on strategic technology initiatives and standards development.
* Provide solution-level architectural decisions in line with enterprise architectural standards.
* Contribute to architectural decision frameworks for cloud, AI, and infrastructure domains.
* Aligning foundational technology capabilities with digital innovation requirements across the organization.

*Solutions Engineering Practice Development*

* Define technical patterns, standards, and best practices for the emerging Solutions Engineering team.
* Establish solution design methodologies that balance pharmaceutical compliance with innovation speed.
* Participate in hiring and developing additional Solutions Engineers across specialized domains.
* Create technical documentation, reference architecture, and implementation guides.

*AIOps & Intelligent Operations Leadership*

* Design and promote AIOps capabilities for infrastructure and DevOps automation.
* Oversee implementation of intelligent monitoring, predictive analytics, and automated remediation. Collaborate with the agentic AI core team to integrate AI-powered operations into the pharmaceutical technology stack.
* Drive adoption of ML-powered capacity planning, anomaly detection, and self-healing systems.

**About You**
**Required Experience:**
**Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise**

* 8+ years in enterprise infrastructure and engineering roles with increasing technical leadership
* Deep expertise in AWS and Azure with production-scale implementations
* Advanced Kubernetes experience, including EKS/AKS in enterprise pharmaceutical or regulated environments.
* Hybrid cloud architecture integrating on-premises systems with cloud-native applications.
* Infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, storage, compute, and security at enterprise scale.

**DevOps & Automation Mastery**

* Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools at scale.
* CI/CD pipeline design, including automated testing, security scanning, and compliance validation.
* Container orchestration with production Kubernetes implementations and cloud-native patterns
* Observability platform experience, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing.

**Strategic & Consultative Leadership**

* Cross-functional collaboration guiding technical decisions across diverse business and technology teams.
* Standards development, creating technical patterns, and best practices adopted across organizations.
* Stakeholder communication, translating technical concepts for business leaders and non-technical audiences.

**Highly Valued Experience**

* Hands-on AI/ML infrastructure deployment, including model serving, training clusters, and data pipelines.
* AIOps implementation experience on AWS (CloudWatch Insights, Systems Manager, DevOps Guru, or equivalent)
* ML platform operations with experience in SageMaker, Azure ML, or similar enterprise ML platforms
* Intelligent automation, including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and automated remediation.
* Pharmaceutical or life sciences technology implementation with GxP compliance understanding
* Regulated industry background (healthcare, financial services, government) with validation experience
* Large-scale digital transformations in organizations with 10,000+ users
* Multi-cloud governance and FinOps implementation with measurable cost optimization outcomes
* Site Reliability Engineering practices, including error budgets, SLOs, and incident management.
* Open-source contributions to cloud-native, Kubernetes, or AI/ML infrastructure projects

**Essential Capabilities**
**Technical Leadership**

* Lead complex technical discussions with confidence and credibility across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Challenge technical assumptions constructively while respecting domain expertise.
* Balance innovation adoption with operational stability and pharmaceutical compliance.
* Make sound architectural decisions in the face of ambiguity and incomplete information.

**Strategic Thinking**

* Connect technical solutions to pharmaceutical business outcomes and patient impact.
* Anticipate future technology trends and proactively prepare infrastructure capabilities.
* Design solutions that scale globally across diverse regulatory environments
* Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term architectural vision.

**Collaborative Influence**

* Build trust and credibility with digital peer organizations through consistent delivery.
* Navigate matrix organizations and drive consensus without formal authority.
* Partner effectively with Enterprise Architecture while maintaining a solutions delivery focus.
* Mentor and develop engineering talent through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.

**Communication Excellence**

* Articulate complex technical architectures clearly for both technical and business audiences.
* Create compelling technical documentation, reference architectures, and implementation guides.
* Facilitate productive technical discussions across distributed, global teams.

**Required**
**Education & Credentials:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field
* Equivalent: 8+ years of Progressive cloud and technology engineering may substitute

**Preferred & Valued**

* AWS certifications: Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Machine Learning Specialty
* Azure certifications: Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert, AI Engineer Associate
* Kubernetes certifications: CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer)
* Additional relevant certifications: Terraform Associate, TOGAF, ITIL, Agile/DevOps

**Reporting To**

* Head of Solutions Engineering (Technology Principal)

**Travel**

* Required for digital partner engagement and strategic initiatives (10%)

**Why This Role Is Unique**
**Foundational Impact**

* You are not joining an established team; you will be one of the first on a team tasked to build out the Solutions Engineering practice.
* Define standards, establish patterns, and create methodologies that will guide Sanofi’s technology transformation for years to come.

**Strategic Influence**

* Lead solution design with digital peer organizations supporting drug discovery, manufacturing automation, and regulatory compliance. Your technical decisions directly impact pharmaceutical innovation timelines and patient outcomes.

**AI Transformation Leadership**

* Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI-powered operations. Design AIOps platforms that revolutionize how pharmaceutical technology operates while supporting our agentic AI transformation initiatives.

**Technical & Strategic Balance**

* This role is both hands-on and strategic. Spend 70% of your time building and implementing solutions, and 30% shaping technical vision and guiding digital partner organizations.

**Architecture Partnership**

* Work directly with Enterprise Architecture on strategic initiatives while maintaining a solutions delivery focus to accelerate pharmaceutical innovation. Connect enterprise standards with practical implementation.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

. You’ll also provide technical leadership and influence across engineering teams.

* Architect, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows across the SDLC and broader business processes.

* Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership rather than technology trends.

* Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems.
* Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC.

* Provide Staff-level technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams.
* Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results.

**Requirements**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes.
* Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems.
* Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as Java, Python, Go, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools.

* Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems—not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles.

* Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

**Preferred**

* Experience spanning traditional software engineering and AI engineering—for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience.
* Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
****About InvoiceCloud**
:**
InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group. Judges also highlighted our mission to reduce digital exclusion and restore simplicity and dignity to how people pay for essential services, as well as our leadership in AI maturity and responsible innovation. It’s an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud.com.
  
  
**About InvoiceCloud**
InvoiceCloud is the leading digital payments platform for utilities, insurance carriers, municipalities, and financial institutions. We enable billers to present bills digitally and collect payments across every channel — driving digital adoption, reducing costs, and improving the customer experience. With 3,000+ billing organizations, 240M+ invoices, and $38B+ in annual payment volume, we're investing heavily in AI to transform from a best-in-class payments processor into a Billing Intelligence Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're building a shared AI platform that powers the next generation of our product portfolio — multi-agent orchestration, ML scoring infrastructure, and LLM-powered intelligence products. As Principal AI Engineer, you'll architect this platform, set the technical direction, and define the engineering standards that the organization builds against.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role — not a management position. You set architectural direction and write production code every day. You think in ADRs, trade-off matrices, and failure modes. You use Claude Code and AI accelerators to operate at 3–5x speed, and you teach the team to do the same.
  
  
Your work directly shapes a growing AI product portfolio. The platform you architect becomes the shared foundation — every subsequent product launches faster because of the infrastructure decisions you make now.
  
  
You'll be based in India, working hybrid (3 days in-office per week), and will report to the VP of Engineering / CTO.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
****Own AI Platform Architecture :****

* Design the full AI platform — multi-agent orchestration, ML inference infrastructure, LLM gateway, tool registry, and eval/observability stack
* Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) that the organization builds against
* Make build-vs-buy decisions, evaluate emerging frameworks (A2A, MCP, Visa TAP), and define integration patterns
* Design system-level concerns: auth gating, policy enforcement (OPA), API gateway patterns (Kong), and multi-tenant isolation
* Define reference architectures for AI-enabled services across .NET 10 APIs, Python ML workloads, React frontends, AKS deployments, Kong gateway integration, and Azure DevOps delivery pipelines

****Drive Product AI Strategy :****

* Partner with Product and CTO office to translate business objectives into AI technical strategy
* Identify where AI creates differentiated value — predictive models, conversational agents, intelligent automation
* Evaluate and de-risk emerging technologies. Present to executive leadership on AI capabilities, costs, and competitive positioning
* Define the AI FinOps strategy: token metering, model routing for cost optimization, quota management, and budget forecasting
* Establish clear platform decision rules for when AI capabilities should be implemented as .NET services, Python services, Azure ML pipelines, background jobs, or embedded product workflows

****AI Safety, Governance And Responsible AI :****

* Define and enforce the Responsible AI framework — content safety guardrails, PII governance, bias testing, and audit trails
* Ensure all AI systems meet PCI DSS, SOC 2, and emerging AI regulation requirements
* Establish model validation and governance processes — transparency, explainability, and fairness are non-negotiable
* Build the trust infrastructure that enables the organization to deploy AI confidently in regulated financial services
* Champion ethical AI principles; ensure all agents and models comply with global financial regulations and internal compliance standards

****Write Code - Everyday :****

* Write production code, review critical PRs, debug complex agent interactions, and prototype new capabilities
* Lead by example — your code quality, testing discipline, and documentation set the standard
* Use Claude Code and AI accelerators daily. Build custom skills, MCP integrations, and automation workflows

****Mentor And Multiply The Team :****

* Raise the AI engineering bar across the organization. Run design reviews, pair on complex problems
* Champion AI-accelerated development — train the team on Claude Code workflows, custom skills, and agentic tooling
* Define engineering standards, evaluation criteria, and best practices that scale beyond your direct team

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in AI/ML — you've architected and shipped production AI systems
* System design mastery — multi-agent architectures, ML platforms, or large-scale inference systems
* Azure + Microsoft AI stack deep expertise — Azure ML, AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, .NET agent frameworks
* Python + .NET bilingual — Python for ML/data, .NET/C# for agent runtimes
* LLM systems at production scale — prompt management, RAG, content safety, agentic workflows
* AI-first development velocity — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent at 3–5x speed
* Deep experience architecting modern .NET cloud-native platforms — including API-first service design, distributed systems, Kubernetes deployment, gateway integration, and CI/CD governance

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* FinTech / Payments architecture — PCI DSS, SOC 2, regulated AI
* Agentic Commerce & A2A — Google A2A, MCP, Visa TAP
* Technical leadership track record — mentored teams, ADR processes, C-level presentations
* Omnichannel & voice AI — web chat, voice, SMS, Azure Communication Services
* ML platform engineering — model registries, feature stores, drift detection
* Published or open-source contributions in AI/ML

Education
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematics, or a related technical field required. A Master's degree is preferred — but we value what you've built and the systems you've architected over credentials.

title: AI Test Architect
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WS Audiology continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
We’re looking for an
**AI Test Architect**
to define, implement, and scale the next generation of quality engineering powered by AI. You will own the
**test architecture strategy**
end-to-end—combining
**LLM-driven automation**
,
**computer vision**
, and
**hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems**
—to deliver robust, scalable, and privacy-first testing for
**mobile applications and hardware-integrated products**
.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on architecture role: you’ll set the strategy, establish standards, lead technical decision-making, and build reusable platforms and frameworks while mentoring teams across QA, Dev, and DevOps.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* AI Test Strategy & Architecture
* Define and maintain the enterprise test architecture, roadmap, and standards spanning functional, non-functional, integration, mobile, and HIL layers.
* Drive a shift-left and automation-first culture; architect frameworks that are modular, resilient, and easy to evolve.
* Establish test design principles, risk-based testing approaches, and coverage models aligned with business goals and compliance requirements.
* Lead architecture reviews and decision forums; evaluate build vs. buy for AI tooling and frameworks.
* AI-Driven Test Innovation (LLMs, RAG, CV/OCR)
* Architect and implement RAG-based test generation using local LLMs (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp) and frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex to reason over requirements, app states, and logs.
* Build AI agents that can: interpret acceptance criteria, propose and prioritize test scenarios, and auto-generate test cases/scripts.
* Develop computer-vision and OCR pipelines (OpenCV, Tesseract, or equivalent) for precise UI validation, visual diffing, and visual regression analysis.
* Design models for UI anomaly detection, flakiness prediction, and self-healing locators beyond traditional Appium-style selectors.
* Automate localization testing for text, layout, and formatting across languages and screen sizes using AI.
* Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Mobile Systems
* Define and evolve a Python-based HIL framework for end-to-end validation of Mobile/Desktop/WebApp interacting with hardware (e.g., medical devices, sensors, wearables).
* Architect communication interfaces (USB, Bluetooth, Serial) and test harnesses to control/observe device interactions reliably at scale.
* Incorporate AI-driven adapters that learn device behaviors, detect drift, and improve robustness of HIL scenarios over time.
* Partner with mobile teams (Android/iOS) to integrate Appium/Espresso/XCUITest/FlaUI where appropriate and augment with AI components.
* On-Prem Infrastructure & MLOps for Test at Scale
* Design on-prem/private-cloud inference infrastructure for low-latency, high-throughput model execution with strong data privacy guarantees.
* Containerize models and agents (Docker) and integrate into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for parallel execution and test-on-commit workflows.
* Implement continuous learning loops to leverage test failures, telemetry, and labels to retrain and improve models.
* Establish model lifecycle practices (versioning, evaluation, rollback, governance) using tools like MLflow/Langchain, self-hosted vector stores, and caching.
* Automation Platforms & Tooling
* Extend or replace traditional frameworks (e.g., Appium) with AI-assisted components that enhance stability and coverage.
* Build Python-based toolchains for model training/inference and integrations into test workflows; standardize reusable libraries and templates.
* Define reference architectures for UI, API, performance, security, and resilience testing; ensure seamless observability, logging, and triage workflows.
* Quality Governance, Metrics & Risk
* Define quality gates, entry/exit criteria, and release readiness bars; ensure compliance and privacy-by-design.
* Track and publish leading indicators and outcome metrics—defect escape rate, test yield, visual regression detection rate, flakiness, mean-time-to-detect/triage, inference latency, infra utilization.
* Conduct root cause analyses and drive systemic fixes across tooling, test design, and pipelines.
* Audit processes for adherence to standards; champion continuous improvement.
* Technical Leadership & Enablement
* Mentor QA engineers and SDETs on AI/ML testing, HIL, and architectural best practices.
* Facilitate collaboration across QA, Development, Data/ML, Security, and DevOps.
* Curate internal playbooks, patterns, sample repos, and training content to scale adoption.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Have
  
  

* 10+ years in Quality Engineering / Software Development, with 5+ years in test architecture / QA leadership.
* Strong Python expertise and hands-on experience with AI/ML in testing contexts.
* Proven experience training or fine-tuning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
* Solid background in Computer Vision (OpenCV) and OCR for UI/visual validation.
* Track record building automation frameworks for mobile and/or device-integrated systems, and clear understanding of limitations of traditional tools (e.g., Appium).
* Experience with CI/CD, Docker, and deploying AI models into test or production environments.
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy, set standards, and lead cross-functional technical initiatives.

Highly Desirable
  
  

* Hands-on with local LLMs (Ollama, llama.cpp) and RAG using LangChain/LlamaIndex.
* Prior experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) or Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing.
* Familiarity with Android/iOS ecosystems and tooling (ADB, Xcode, Fastlane, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox).
* Observability and analytics (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) for test health and triage.
* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., medical devices) and familiarity with risk management and compliance (e.g., ISO 13485, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 14971, HIPAA/GDPR) is a plus.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic thinker with a builder’s mindset and strong systems design instincts.
* Excellent communicator who simplifies complex concepts and aligns stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, bias for action, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
* Passion for mentoring and uplifting engineering excellence across teams.

Success Metrics (Examples)
  
  

* >40% reduction in flaky test failures and >30% faster triage through AI triage/visual diffing.
* >25% increase in critical defect detection pre-release (vs. prior baseline).
* P95 AI inference latency within target SLA for CI pipelines.
* Adoption of standardized AI-assisted frameworks across X product teams within Y quarters.
* Documented compliance with privacy and model governance standards.

Tech Stack (Indicative)
  
  

* Languages/Frameworks: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, LangChain/LlamaIndex
* LLMs/Inference: Ollama, llama.cpp, local vector DBs (FAISS/Chroma), Triton Inference Server (optional)
* Mobile & Automation: Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, FlaUI, and Azure DevOps
* HIL/Protocols: USB, Bluetooth, Serial; vendor SDKs; Python-based device controllers
* CI/CD & Infra: Azure DevOps, self hosted Ubuntu / MacOS instances
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

Personal competencies
  
  

* Strong leadership and coordination skills.
* Excellent communication skills in professional written and spoken English.
* Detail-oriented with a structured and analytical approach.
* Ability to work collaboratively across global teams.
* Proactive mindset with a focus on quality and compliance.

Who we are
  
  
At WS Audiology, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**
WS Audiology is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

title: Sr. LLM Fine Tuning Engineer
description:
BCI has an open remote position on our GenAI team working with our USA based client. The LLM Fine Tuning Engineer will join our offshore development team that is growing and there is a lot of new and exciting GenAI work to be completed. This is a full-time remote position and must be able to work blended hours of EST / IST timings. Position will have a mix of LLM Fine tuning and hands-on Python and GenAI development.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an LLM Fine Tuning Engineer with python and GenAI background to work on customization and optimization of large language models for production use cases. This role owns the full fine-tuning lifecycle — from data preparation through training, evaluation, and deployment — working with open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Gemma) as well as proprietary/managed models (e.g., Google Gemini) where fine-tuning access is available. You'll be hands-on with real training runs at scale, not just prompt engineering, or API integration.

**What You'll Do**

* Fine-tune and adapt large language models (Llama, Gemma, and other open-weight models, plus managed options like Gemini where applicable) for specific business use cases
* Design and execute full fine-tuning pipelines: dataset curation and cleaning, tokenization, training/eval splits, hyperparameter selection, and training runs (full fine-tune, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT, RLHF/DPO as appropriate)
* Run and manage large-scale training jobs across multi-GPU / distributed environments
* Evaluate model performance using both automated benchmarks and human-in-the-loop review; iterate to close quality gaps
* Optimize models for production inference (quantization, distillation, latency/cost tradeoffs)
* Deploy fine-tuned models into production systems and monitor performance, drift, and degradation over time
* Collaborate with data, ML infrastructure, and product teams to define fine-tuning objectives and success metrics
* Stay current on the open-model landscape and evaluate new base models as candidates for fine-tuning
* Document methodology, training runs, and results for reproducibility and knowledge sharing

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals (not just notebooks)
* Hands-on, production-level experience fine-tuning LLMs — this is a must-have, not exploratory/academic experience only
* Demonstrated experience taking fine-tuned models into live, large-scale production systems (not just POCs)
* AWS and /or Google cloud production experience will be considered
* Experience with open-weight model families (e.g., Llama, Gemma, Mistral, or similar)
* Practical knowledge of fine-tuning techniques: LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT, full fine-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF/DPO
* Experience with ML/training frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers/TRL/PEFT, DeepSpeed, or similar
* Familiarity with distributed/multi-GPU training and the associated infrastructure challenges
* Solid understanding of model evaluation methodology for generative models

**Nice to Have**

* Experience fine-tuning or customizing Google Gemini or other managed/API-based models
* Experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or hybrid RAG + fine-tuning approaches
* Experience with MLOps tooling for training pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI)
* Experience with model quantization and inference optimization (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, GGUF, etc.)
* Background in NLP research or publications related to LLM training/fine-tuning

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first few months, you're independently running fine-tuning jobs on open models, have a clear point of view on which base models and techniques fit which use cases, and have shipped at least one fine-tuned model into a production system with measurable quality improvement over baseline.

**Interview Process:**

1. If profile appears to fit role, we will send you a request for more information and details on your background. 2. Initial 30 min MS Teams conversation with BCI-IT team to go over your hands on experience and determine fit. 3. If potential fit, you will be sent a video technical screen with 8 questions on Python, GenAI and LLM fine tuning. 4. 45 min to 1 hour client technical interview with Python code share activity. You will be speaking with 2-3 Sr. team members. Hiring decision can be made after call.

description:

Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.

* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows

* 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development

* Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability

Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.

title: AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents)
description:
**Req ID:**
386620
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Engineer (Generative AI / MLOps / AI Agents) to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
We are seeking a skilled and motivated
**AI Engineer**
(Mid-Level) to join contract basis. This role sits at the intersection of
**Generative AI, MLOps, and Intelligent Agent development**
— and is responsible for designing, building, and deploying AI-powered solutions that directly support our P&C insurance operations.
  
  
You will work closely with our data engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver
**LLM-powered applications, automated AI agents, and production-ready ML pipelines**
across claims, underwriting, and actuarial domains. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for an engineer who is comfortable moving from architecture whiteboard to working code.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
*Generative AI & LLM Engineering*

* Design, fine-tune, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs) for insurance-specific use cases including document intelligence, claims summarization, policy interpretation, and underwriting Q&A.
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, ChromaDB) to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge bases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and systematic evaluation pipelines to ensure LLM output quality, consistency, and safety in regulated insurance contexts.
* Integrate LLM capabilities with internal data platforms via LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Evaluate and benchmark foundational models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Llama) against insurance-specific tasks to guide platform selection.

*AI Agents & Automation*

* Architect and implement autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, and decision-making for workflows such as FNOL triage, claims routing, policy lookup, and compliance checks.
* Build agentic frameworks using patterns such as ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, and Tool-Augmented Agents to handle complex, multi-turn insurance workflows.
* Design human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints and escalation logic to ensure AI agents operate within defined risk and compliance boundaries.
* Integrate agents with internal APIs, data platforms, and enterprise systems using orchestration tools such as Azure Logic Apps, Apache Airflow, or Databricks Workflows.
* Develop guardrails, monitoring, and audit logging for all deployed agents to meet regulatory and governance standards.

*MLOps & Model Deployment*

* Build and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering model training, versioning, validation, deployment, and monitoring using MLflow, Azure ML, and Databricks.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enabling reliable, repeatable model releases.
* Deploy models as REST APIs or batch inference services on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps, ensuring scalability and low-latency response.
* Establish model monitoring frameworks to detect data drift, model degradation, and prediction anomalies in production.
* Manage the model registry and lineage tracking to maintain governance and auditability of all AI assets.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure feature pipelines are production-grade, versioned, and integrated with the Feature Store on Databricks or Azure ML.

*Collaboration & Delivery*

* Work closely with business analysts, actuaries, underwriters, and claims professionals to translate domain requirements into AI solution designs.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives as an active delivery contributor.
* Produce clear, well-structured technical documentation including solution designs, API specs, model cards, and deployment runbooks.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal AI engineering best practices and standards.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Master's degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with demonstrated delivery of production-grade AI systems.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
* Proven experience implementing MLOps pipelines in cloud environments (Azure preferred).
* Experience developing AI agents or automation workflows using agentic frameworks.
* Prior experience in financial services, insurance, or regulated industries is strongly preferred.

*Technical Skills*
Generative AI & LLMs
  
  

* OpenAI / Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo), Claude, Mistral, or open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Falcon)
* RAG architectures, vector search, embeddings (OpenAI, Cohere, SentenceTransformers)
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel
* Prompt engineering, few-shot learning, instruction tuning, RLHF concepts

AI Agents & Automation
  
  

* Agentic frameworks: ReAct, Tool-Augmented Agents, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI
* Workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows, Azure Logic Apps
* API design and integration: REST, GraphQL, Webhooks

MLOps & Model Serving
  
  

* MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, model serving)
* Azure Machine Learning, Databricks AutoML & Feature Store
* Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps
* CI/CD: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions
* Model monitoring: Evidently AI, Azure ML monitoring, or equivalent

Programming & Data Engineering
  
  

* Python (expert level): PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
* PySpark and Delta Lake for large-scale data processing
* SQL (T-SQL / Spark SQL) for feature engineering and data validation
* Git for version control and collaborative development

Cloud & Platform
  
  

* Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, AKS, Azure Data Factory, Azure Key Vault)
* Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Workflows)
* Microsoft Fabric / OneLake (familiarity a strong plus)
